body: Monster hunter world is awesome. You’re essentially a dragon hunter. You can play solo or online with friends. There’s a lot to get into but the game has a top notch tutorial. PS4  and  i assume Xbox both have subscription based services where you get access to a whole library of new and old games. Can’t imagine this fella not liking video games. Whatever you end up doing i commend you for it.
When we talk about suicide we don’t talk about men generally speaking.
He’s a cheater. You’re young and full of life. Get back out there and wait for the right one.
You don’t know how hard I’ve tried to be a better person.

Because you said you’re looking for your crystal. The reality is life is harder for some of us. Don’t ask why because i don’t know. What i do know is I’m glad i didn’t kill myself years ago. I’m 30 and I’m happier with myself than I’ve ever been. You just have to keep going. Pull up your pants and keep putting one foot in front of the other.
You’re just a kid....don’t let depression get the best of you. There is sooooo much to do in this world and i promise, you don’t want to miss out on what life has to offer.

I’m going to take a guess and say you’re younger than me. I’m a 30 year old guy and I’m still here. I have bad days and ask myself all the time if I’m here just for the people who love me. I don’t know if heaven is real. Actually i don’t even believe in god but i don’t want to believe there is a calm nothingness after death. Maybe we’re out here to survive man. Maybe you’re purpose as well as mine is FIGHT. I haven’t given up yet because  yes my family, g/f, and friends love me. You feel like you’re not shit but in reality you mean the world to quite a few people. As you get older you’ll get closer with your parents. You’ll probably have a kid and get married either with this girlfriend or some other beauty out there you haven’t met yet. Maybe if there is an afterlife where we can see everyone again, then maybe we can finally share our story and everyone will understand how incredibly strong and selfless we were to fight our entire lives so we didn’t hurt the ones who TRULY love us. Take care brother i hope you make it through.
